reviews.name: Eswaran K S
reviews.body: After conducting detailed survey we planned to go from Kathmandu to Mukthinath. We had taken details from Base camp and others. However , I really appreciate the excellent follow up from Base camp that we decided to go with them. We are extremely happy with the way the tour was conducted. We had an excellent driver for us ( Bala ) , good hotels in Pokhara and Jomson. Also Shiv Bhatta was always available for us for any clarifications. We would strongly recommend anybody to go with them for tours. Thanks Base camp for making our tour very successful. We are extremely thankful and you should continue your service in the same manner.

reviews.name: Odyssey20212645309
reviews.title: Hopeless driver rest is good
reviews.body: Very unprofessional driver spoiled our tourBasecamp needs to trained the driver otherwise will loose business in future or else keep nepali drivers instead of gorakhpur driversBase camp hotel accommodations were excellent They planned the tour as perfect to my requirement Base camp team was supportive and attended all the calls to solve any problems during tour Base camp team Savita n vikram bhatta thank you so much for your support

reviews.name: Gina H
reviews.title: Everest Base Camp luxury Lodge trek with helicopter
reviews.body: Our trip was absolutely Magical!Being amidst the snow capped Himalayas was other worldly however, Base Camp Adventure, Shree Ghimire and our outstanding guide Prakash are what really made this trip incredible and seamless.Prakash did a wonderful job guiding to EBC safely and fully acclimatized. He also made sure we always had the best rooms and amenities available as each day the quality of the lodges can change significantly. He always prepared us for what to expect. Prakash was also very patient while we took hundreds of photos and took our time taking in the breathtaking views. In short, this trip is an adventure of a lifetime.

reviews.name: Erika H
reviews.title: EBC 2025
reviews.body: Our trip to Everest Base Camp with Base Camp Adveture and Prakash as our guide was amazing . Every day brought the discovery of a more stunning path with views of the Himalayas , and new learnings about the Sherpa culture and region. Prakash made sure that we were always well taken care of and lead the way perfectly guaranteeing our safe arrival to EBC. He always made sure we would get the best amenities available and was very honest preparing us on what to expect of each new lodge understanding that the standard of “luxury” is different as you ascend and reach tose high altitude very remote places . One needs to be realistic on the expectations of the lodges . From our arrival to Kathmandu to reaching EBC we always felt safe and very well taken care of ! The helicopter return is a must . This is truly a life time trip. The Himalayas and their majesty will take your breath away .

reviews.name: Barbara E
reviews.title: Amazing trek!
reviews.body: Amazing trek, the best guide, Shiva took such good care of us!From the time we met in Kathmandu until our flight back from Lukla, we couldn't have asked for a better guide and porters! And the trek, hard to describe, but one of the most challenging experiences of my life, both physically and mentally. Beautiful views, difficult trails, perfect weather, comfortable accommodations. We requested upgraded tea houses, which were worthwhile as we always had en-suite bathrooms and sometimes hot showers in the rooms.Shiva thought of every detail, I would travel with him again in a second!

reviews.name: travelvore22
reviews.title: An amazing adventure!
reviews.body: Fantastic experience! Gokyo trek is beautiful. Our guide, Shiva, was amazing!! He took such good care of us, arranged everything perfectly, was so knowledgeable about the region and culture, and was a pleasure to hang out with. Our porters, Palden and Chandra, were also wonderful - so sweet and fun to be around. Shree did a great job answering our myriad of questions before the trek via email, and was always accessible during to trek to coordinate last minute plan changes. I would highly recommend Base Camp Adventures, and Shiva in particular as q guide. It was an adventure I’ll never forget!!

reviews.name: Cruiser50246910613
reviews.title: The best Solo trip I've ever had
reviews.body: I traveled alone in this trekking trip , It was incredible trip . All services are perfect for me , started from pick up at the airport on time to the hotel. My guide during trekking , his name is Dhakal Saroj , He is really good at his job ,very nice guy and friendly as well . He is not just lead a way but given clear brief and many useful advice, taking a photo for me . It's like the best services that I ever had. If anyone would like to go to the trekking trip in Nepal , I would recommend him to be your guide.

reviews.name: Discover27412362660
reviews.title: Not Great
reviews.body: I was doing a solo trek in Himalayas for the first time for which I reached out to them for hiring a guide. While they were were friendly during the conversation and assured of an excellent guide, the actual guide provided was quite unprofessional. He would walk either far ahead or far behind ,e while I would walk alone .He would not take care of food arrangements as well while the other guides would do it for their clients. On one of the days, he would rude and also argued because he was getting late for reaching back to Pokhara. On highlighting it to the agency, they just listened and did not not even acknowledged and apologized for this. Will not recommend at all.

reviews.name: James W
reviews.title: Amazing Manaslu 🇳🇵
reviews.body: My sister and I enjoyed 11 days on the Manaslu circuit (MCAP). Amazing experience seeing the transition from Hindu Nepali culture to a mix of Tibetan Bhuddist as we moved through the circuit.Prakash was incredibly professional and was a joy to have as our guide. He put our safety and comfort first and gave us many options to maximise our experience in the mountains! Would highly recommend him as a guide for any trekkers.

reviews.name: Traveller20175
reviews.title: Well organized tour
reviews.body: I want to thank Shree Ghimire ji for the awesome trip we had to Nepal. He worked about the itinerary with us and tailored one for us based on our inputs. We comprehensively covered all the places that we wanted to visit, since ours was more of a cultural trip of Nepal. All our hotels were excellent and we had a great experience in Nepal.

reviews.name: xclairelouise
reviews.title: Incredible Experience with Base Camp Adventures - Gokyo and Cho La Pass Trek
reviews.body: My friend and I rcently completed the Gokyo Lake and Cho La Pass trek with Base Camp Adventures, and I can honestly say it was one of the most unforgettable experiences of my life. From start to finish, the entire team at Base Camp Adventures exceeded all expectations.Our guide (Shiva) was exceptionally knowledgeable, not only about the trail but also about the local culture and geography, enriching the journey in ways I hadn't anticipated. He was always attentive to our needs, ensuring we were comfortable and safe, especially as we navigated the challenging terrain of the Cho La Pass. Our porter (Shandra) too, was incredibly hardworking and always with a smile, carrying our gear without a hitch and showing remarkable dedication throughout.The trek itself was certainly demanding, but the stunning views made every tough step worth it. The panoramas of the snow-capped peaks, glaciers, and crystal-clear lakes were nothing short of breathtaking. Gokyo's beauty is unparalleled, and crossing the Cho La Pass, with its rugged, high-altitude landscape, was a true adventure which we'll never forget. The owner of Base Camp Adventures (Shree) was also fantastic. From the initial inquiry to the end of the trek, the communication was seamless, and they made sure every detail was taken care of, allowing us to focus entirely on the experience. Their professionalism and genuine care for their clients shine through in everything they do.If you're looking for a company that combines expert guidance, exceptional service, and a genuine passion for trekking in the Himalayas, I can't recommend Base Camp Adventures highly enough. The trek was challenging but incredibly rewarding, and I look forward to my next adventure with them! ☺ ⛰

reviews.name: Inge D
reviews.title: Manang valley from Jagat to the Ice Lake.
reviews.body: A wonderful experience with Prakash as a guide and Binayk as a carrier. We were able to make some changes within the program which still gives a free feeling. We left from Jagat to the Ice Lake which was the icing on the cake. Both guided us to 4,600 meters altitude with a fantastic view of the Annapurna range. This organization is definitely recommended!

reviews.name: Vicki H
reviews.title: A beautiful and exciting trek with great support
reviews.body: This was an extremely beautiful trek with so many high points and plenty of time for acclimatisation. It was actually 13 days of trekking with shorter days while ascending and longer days when descending and we had 2 much needed acclimatisation days one in exciting Namche Bazar at 3400m and the other at Gokyo near the amazingly picturesque 3rd lake.Our guide Shiva was always helping, leading and informing us and became our trusted companion and friend, supporting and encouraging us through all of the challenging moments as well as the fun ones. Nothing was too much trouble for him and he took great care of us at all times both when walking and at mealtimes.Our porter Chandra also deserves a mention for his constant friendly presence and seemingly never ending stamina!Furthermore, Shree from Base Camp Adventures was extremely communicative on the run. up to the trek answering all of our questions promptly and thoroughly!Thanks to the whole team we both succeeded in reaching all the goals of the trek including Base Camp of course!
